role: rail control plates for the measured 135.88x70 undo and 132x70 resign boxes
not: a slice or stretch of button-steel-rest, and not a shrink of the boxes
change: redrawn without the large left bolt so the centred label sits on the recessed panel, not on a bolt
covers: opaque to all four edges, so contain fills the measured box and no background shows at the edges or corners
fit: uniform scale to width 1538, vertical centre crop to height 294, then the centre length removed to the measured box aspect; uniform resample only, never 100% 100%
pressed: same pixels as rest, lighting only
webp: libwebp quality 82; opaque lossy VP8, no alpha channel
tool: cx built-in image_gen, account2, no PixelLab
